description: Original bounded algebra algorithm with independent finite checks
cost: Fixed prime998244353. Solve g^x=t; n=ceil sqrt(p-1), store least j for g^j then scan t*(g^-n)^i. First matching block gives least exponent. Nonzero group exponent range0..p-2; zero base: t=1=>0,t=0=>1, otherwise none. O(sqrt(p)log p) BTreeMap work O(sqrt(p)) memory. Shanks, Class number, a theory of factorization, and genera (1971).
forward: Fixed prime998244353. Solve g^x=t; n=ceil sqrt(p-1), store least j for g^j then scan t*(g^-n)^i. First matching block gives least exponent. Nonzero group exponent range0..p-2; zero base: t=1=>0,t=0=>1, otherwise none. O(sqrt(p)log p) BTreeMap work O(sqrt(p)) memory. Shanks, Class number, a theory of factorization, and genera (1971).
inverse: Some(x) with g^x!=target or with a smaller valid exponent is excluded. None is excluded when any exponent0..p-2 solves for nonzero g. Zero base explicitly adds exponent1 for target0.

For output Some(0), every base paired with target1 is compatible. For x>0 retain pairs (g,g^x) whose multiplicative order exceeds x, plus (0,0) at x1. None admits nonmembers of generated subgroups, including (1,2).
limitations: Partial syntax; finite tests do not prove universal correctness; no allocator failure injection; no executable surrogate
